# Rose Binet

Rose Binet is the current Deputy of [District 9](https://flow.je/elections/district-9) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Rose Binet has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rose-binet#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 9 with 47.6% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/rose-binet/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RZWOYpQ-Qo0)

Rose Binet has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 9](https://flow.je/elections/district-9). \[[app.jerseyeveningpost.com](https://app.jerseyeveningpost.com/assistant-minister-hopes-for-re-election-in-eastern-district/content.html)\]

## Election History

**Rose Binet was elected as Deputy of District 9 in 2022**.
